title: Two members
prompt: Declare two variables at the top of the script (member variables): `health` equal to 100 and `level` equal to 1. Return health plus level.
hints: Member variables are declared one per line, outside the functions.
`var health = 100` and `var level = 1` at the top.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var health = 100
var level = 1

func solve():
	return health + level
